descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-12 Important Points · S01 Hospital: Save Note leaves the panel empty, three Add Point cards survive a re-save untouched

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 The panel is physician-authored only (PR #49): nothing is generated from the pre-round note, and saving a pre-round note on a patient with no points leaves the Important Points panel empty. … (UAT TC-12; TFA-92590 AC 2; TFA-92590 description) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U2 Three points added via '+ Add Point', one per line, show as three separate cards, not one merged card, in both Hospital and Nursing Home (Nursing Home per PR #57). (UAT TC-12; TFA-92590 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U3 Re-saving the pre-round note with different content leaves every point untouched: Save Note never adds, edits, or removes a point. (UAT TC-12; TFA-92590 AC 2; TFA-92590 description) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Fresh physician with one Hospital patient and no points

When Type note A in the pre-round editor and Save Note; reopen and check the panel; add three points one at a time with Add Point / Save Point; replace the note with note B and Save Note; reopen

Then After the first save the panel is empty. After adding, exactly three cards with the typed texts. After the re-save the same three cards, same text and order, nothing added

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT TC-12 steps 1-3, Expected bullets 1-3; TFA-92590 AC 2-3. Checkpoints, judged now: cp1 has no card (no 'Delete point' / 'Edit point' control; the empty-state wording is not checked, it may be reworded); cp2 and cp3 show the three typed texts. backendChecks, judged only once the runner reads them (oracleRules 1): no point after the first Save Note; …

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S01 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-12.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
